import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.colors as mcolors

labels = ['Vanilla', 'MLM', '9-Class']

deberta_iid = np.array([
    [1.0,   0.442, 0.393],
    [0.442, 1.0,   0.586],
    [0.393, 0.586, 1.0  ],
])
deberta_ood = np.array([
    [1.0,   0.797, 0.649],
    [0.797, 1.0,   0.773],
    [0.649, 0.773, 1.0  ],
])
roberta_iid = np.array([
    [1.0,   0.393, 0.592],
    [0.393, 1.0,   0.351],
    [0.592, 0.351, 1.0  ],
])
roberta_ood = np.array([
    [1.0,   0.255, 0.735],
    [0.255, 1.0,   0.183],
    [0.735, 0.183, 1.0  ],
])

matrices = [deberta_iid, deberta_ood, roberta_iid, roberta_ood]
titles = ['DeBERTa (IID)', 'DeBERTa (DD OOD)', 'RoBERTa (IID)', 'RoBERTa (DD OOD)']

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(3.4, 3.2), constrained_layout=True)
cmap = plt.cm.YlOrRd
norm = mcolors.Normalize(vmin=0, vmax=1)

for ax, mat, title in zip(axes.flat, matrices, titles):
    im = ax.imshow(mat, cmap=cmap, norm=norm, aspect='equal')
    ax.set_xticks(range(3))
    ax.set_yticks(range(3))
    ax.set_xticklabels(labels, fontsize=7, rotation=45, ha='right')
    ax.set_yticklabels(labels, fontsize=7)
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=8, pad=3)
    for i in range(3):
        for j in range(3):
            val = mat[i, j]
            color = 'white' if val > 0.65 else 'black'
            ax.text(j, i, f'{val:.3f}', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7, color=color)
    ax.tick_params(length=0)

cbar = fig.colorbar(im, ax=axes, shrink=0.85, aspect=30, pad=0.02)
cbar.ax.tick_params(labelsize=7)
cbar.set_label('Centered CKA', fontsize=8)

fig.savefig('/root/persuasion_turn_jailbreak_detect/paper/figures/cka_heatmap.pdf', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
fig.savefig('/root/persuasion_turn_jailbreak_detect/paper/figures/cka_heatmap.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
print('Done')
PYEOF
